# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTERED_RSI_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In low-volatility environments (VIX < 15), pullbacks to RSI levels between 30-40 with bullish EMA alignment (price above both 20-period and 50-period EMA) offer a high-probability long entry opportunity. This setup captures mean-reversion bounces within an underlying uptrend, filtered by volatility and time-of-day to avoid choppy periods and ensure institutional participation.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Enter long (buy calls) when the 5-minute RSI(14) crosses above 30 from below, price is above both the 20-period and 50-period EMA, VIX is below 15, ADX > 18 (to confirm trending context), and time is between 10:00 and 14:00 ET.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the most recent swing low prior to entry (chart-stop). TP1 at 2×R (risk-reward). After TP1, trail the remaining position with a 15% pullback from the highest-since-entry price (runner trail). Time stop at 15:50 ET if not exited earlier.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The strategy assumes Safe account parameters (30% max risk per trade, 3-contract minimum at $1K-$2K equity). For headline P&L scaling, $1K paper account ≈ 14% of nominal qty=28 requirement ($25K+ account needed for full size).  
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed logic derived from conceptual analysis of low-VIX pullback patterns; no historical sample used yet. High overfit risk due to untested parameter thresholds (RSI 30-40, VIX<15, time window 10:00-14:00).  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no validation of entry/exit prices against OPRA bid-ask slippage).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw in low-VIX ranging market causing repeated stopouts; max drawdown scenario: consecutive losses during volatility expansion (VIX>20) triggering false signals; blow-up scenario: gap open against position during overnight news triggering catastrophic stop.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (dependent on signal frequency and win/loss distribution).
